source.publisher: Historic England via Open Data Hub

evidence_slice: Historic England's official Open Data Hub Search API documents a geoservice FeatureServer query surface, and service item 767f279327a24845bf47dfe5eae9862b exposes layer 3 as Listed Building polygons with OGL copyright metadata. The official NHLE entry 1239561 is Nos. 161 and 163 Magdalen Road, Exeter, Grade II, described as a pair of early-C19 detached villas and most recently amended 19-Jul-2016. The exact Hub geoservice-proxy query for ListEntry 1239561 was inaccessible before a feature payload could be read, so no polygon coordinates were inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Historic England service item 767f279327a24845bf47dfe5eae9862b identifies layer 3 as Listed Building polygons, but the exact ListEntry 1239561 query yielded no readable feature payload in the available retrieval channels.
